analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear – the core concept of collaborative music creation is understandable. However, the execution details (undo/redo, DAW-style editing) are somewhat vague.', 'Market Size and Demand': '• Good potential market – musicians are a large and diverse group.
